main.description: One person's bookshelf photo on shelfguessr — a GeoGuessr-style guessing game played over a handle's SimCluster (self + mutuals). Singleton per repo, written via putRecord create-or-update at rkey "self". Read network-wide (listReposByCollection + Jetstream) and filtered down to whichever SimCluster is currently being played to build a round's candidate pool. Written and read by shelfguessr (https://shelfguessr.bisks.net).

photo.description: The bookshelf photo, uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob before saving this record. No client-side size cap beyond the PDS's own blob limits.

caption.description: Optional free-text note about the shelf, revealed to guessers only after they've guessed (so it isn't a giveaway hint mid-round).

updatedAt.description: When this shelf photo was last saved, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
